rationale: The renamed 8.8 aggregate shows Premier on Cloud and Cloud Connected on-premises, with Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The distinct 8.7 and 8.8 task pages both use ES 8.7+ for Cloud. The 8.8 CMP task requires Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0, plus assistant enablement, roles and connector permissions. The assistant overview requires Splunk AI Assistant 2.4+, while the inspected 2.3.6 install notice and SAIA-9918 still describe restored support as planned for 2.4.0. Triage analyzes existing findings, with burst and tenant limits. These sections give prerequisite and discrepancy evidence only.
